Standard: Material used in the air vehicles are fully characterized and meet the technical requirements for materials, materials processing, and materials properties established in MIL- STD-1587. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(1) No prohibited or commonly restricted materials listed in MIL-STD-1587 or MIL-STD-1568 are used in SOF components in the air vehicle design.
(2) Material properties are based on the specific process controls used for component production for process intensive materials such as welding and additive manufacturing, IAW MIL-STD- 1587. Analysis.
  (1) The materials selected for use in the air vehicle meet the technical requirements established in MIL-STD-1587.
  (2) The materials properties used in the air vehicle are design allowables developed IAW MIL- STD-1587 and meet the requirements of ASIP (MIL-STD-1530), PSIP (MIL-STD-3024), RSIP (MIL-STD-3063), or MECSIP (MIL-STD-1798), as applicable.
  (3) The materials properties used in the air vehicle account for processing variation IAW MIL- STD-1587.
  (4) For electrical wiring, insulation is IAW MIL-STD-1587.
